description: For one school, what CourseShelf holds about its transfer relationships and where and why the chain breaks: 1. the school, area by area (agreements, comparability published, comparability inferred, policies, exam credit, programs and checklists, pathways); 2. each feeder and peer, the relationship (agreements, comparability published and inferred, pathways); 3. what to fix, by owner (Gather, Harvest, Serve, Inference, This page). Each line carries one status of the ladder, first break wins: not looked for, not found on the site, found but not gathered, gathered but not harvested, harvested but not served, served but not read by the page, held; with its evidence (the address, the capture, the record file). Nothing missing is shown as 0. Reads the Cabinet read-only; each reading whose statuses changed is kept, and the answer lists what changed since the last one. Answered only to main KSAserver's own key; any other caller is refused.
name: peers_feeders_coverage
title: Peers and Feeders Coverage
